profile.description: American Homes 4 Rent, doing business as AMH, is a real estate investment trust based in Las Vegas, Nevada, that invests in single-family rental homes. As of December 31, 2019, the company owned 52,552 homes in 22 states.
profile.description_zh: American Homes 4 Rent（以AMH名义经营）是一家总部位于内华达州拉斯维加斯的房地产投资信托基金，专注于独栋住宅租赁。截至2019年12月31日，该公司在22个州拥有52,552套住宅。
